It is a choice. It just can’t be me. I can’t be the reason you leave here. If you gave this up for me I’d-I’d never forgive myself. We have to win. We have to beat them and I believe you have purpose in making that happen. I need to believe that. So, I’m choosing for the both of us. I choose the rebellion.|Bix Caleen, to Cassian Andor|{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}}} '''Bix Caleen''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[human]] [[Technician|mechanic]] who was the owner of the [[Caleen Salyard]] on the [[Free Trade sector]] [[planet]] of [[Ferrix]]. She worked alongside [[Timm Karlo]], who was also her lover. She was close with her ex-boyfriend, [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], who trusted her greatly. She also had offworld connections, namely [[Luthen Rael]]. When Andor informed her he was looking to sell a valuable item, Caleen contacted Rael, who was already interested in meeting Andor. When [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] security forces [[Ambush on Ferrix|arrived]] on Ferrix to arrest Andor, who had [[Death|killed]] two of their [[Tac-Corpo|officers]], Caleen learned that Karlo had informed on Andor and ran to help him. However, she was beaten and [[Stuncuffs|handcuffed]] by several [[officer]]s, and when Karlo attempted to help her, he was shot and killed. Caleen was later freed by two men, [[Salman Paak]] and his son [[Wilmon Paak|Wilmon]]. Some time after the Preox-Morlana security forces incident, Bix was interrogated by [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]] and tortured under her orders in her search for leads to Andor. After a lengthy captivity, she was freed by Andor amid a [[Ferrix Riot|riot]], and they fled Ferrix alongside their friends [[Wilmon Paak]] and [[Brasso]], settling on the agricultural world [[Mina-Rau]]. A year later, Imperial forces invaded their relative tranquility while Andor was away on a mission for Rael, and though he returned in time to rescue her and Paak, Brasso was killed. Andor and Caleen spent the next year living in Rael's [[Axis network safehouse|safehouse]] on the Imperial [[capital]] of [[Coruscant]], where she was tormented by [[Dream|nightmares]] of her torturer [[Doctor]] [[Gorst]] and took to taking drugs to alleviate them while Andor ran increasingly dangerous missions for Rael. The two eventually moved to a new home on the Rebel base of [[Yavin 4]], though not until Caleen had her revenge upon Gorst by killing him in a raid on an [[Imperial Security Bureau]] facility. However, Andor grew increasingly content with the couple's life on Yavin and expressed his intent to retire in [[2 BBY]], leading Caleen—who believed Andor's role in the coming [[Galactic Civil War|war]] to be too important—to flee and go into hiding, telling Andor to find her when they had defeated the Empire. She settled back on Mina-Rau, where she gave birth to [[Bix Caleen's child|her and Andor's child]] several months later, though Andor died at the [[Battle of Scarif]] the following year; his sacrifice ensured the Rebellion was able to destroy the [[Death Star]] at the forthcoming [[Battle of Yavin]]. ==Biography== ===Life on Ferrix=== {{Quote|I'm guessing it comes from one of my bids.''"
"''Guess again.''"
"''Not your best move, Cassian.|Bix and Cassian discuss the origin of an item he stole|}} [[File:AndorCaleen-Andor1.png|thumb|left|300px|Intent on contacting her buyer, Bix is visited at her salyard by an old friend, Cassian Andor.]] During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[Proclamation of the New Order|successor]] state of the [[Galactic Republic]], the [[Gender|female]] [[human]] Bix Caleen resided on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]], where she worked as a [[Technician|mechanic]] at the [[Caleen Salyard]]{{SW|url=andor-s1-e1-trivia-gallery|text="Kassa" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 3}}—which she inherited after the [[death]] of her [[parent]]s{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess#!asset/gppr5wpqgb4t74974f8s|text=ANDOR Production Brief V3 FINAL 8-04-22|date=2022-08-04}}—alongside [[Timm Karlo]], who was also her lover. She also had connections with the [[black market]]. In [[5 BBY]], [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], a close friend of Caleen's who was also her former lover, arrived at the [[salvage yard]] and asked her to reach out to one of her contacts, as he had a valuable item he wanted to sell. She replied that he would not arrive for a sole item, as she usually bundled a number of items for him to purchase all at once. As such, she stated that she planned to reach out to him at the end of the [[Standard month|month]]. She added that there was a [[Tac Corvette]] that was coming in during the [[Standard week|week]] looking to scrap, and was said to have Imperial targeting units onboard. She would gather those items, along with Andor's item before contacting him. Andor insisted he could not wait that long, which raised questions from Caleen. She asked him what the item he was carrying was, and Andor reluctantly told her it was an untraceable [[Imperial N-S9 Starpath Unit|NS-9 Starpath unit]]. She questioned how long he had been holding the unit, believing it had come from one of her bids, and that Andor was hiding it from her. Caleen suggested that Andor sell the item to her instead, which he immediately shot down, as he needed every [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] that was to be made from the item, unwilling to share it with a partner. The two were interrupted by Karlo, who asked if Caleen wanted to bid on a run from the planet [[Wobani]]. Caleen brushed him off, which prompted Andor to ask if she and Karlo were more than co-workers. She fired back, stating that she never asked about his personal life, but also assured him that Karlo knew nothing of her under-the-radar dealings. Andor mentioned that Caleen had once said her contact wanted to meet him, and that he really needed to sell the item. Caleen finally agreed, promising to contact her buyer, and told Andor to fix his face before sending him off, as it was bruised due to what he claimed to be "a fall." Unknown to Caleen, however, Andor had returned from the the planet [[Morlana One]] the previous [[Standard day|night]], where he had killed two [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] [[Sentry Corporal]]s—[[Verlo Skiff]] and [[Kravas Drezzer]]. [[File:BixInAction-Andor1.png|thumb|right|300px|At Repaak Salyard, Caleen uses a secret communicator to send a transmission to her mystery buyer.]] Later that day, Caleen left the salvage yard to run "errands," when in reality she was going to contact her buyer. Suspicious of his partner, Karlo followed her through the streets of Ferrix, but eventually lost track of her. Caleen arrived at [[Repaak Salyard]], where [[Salman Paak]] and his son [[Wilmon Paak|Wilmon]] worked, and asked for a "Bendine Mesh-Tech filter." Hesitantly, Paak replied that they were located on a rack in the back, adding she may have to dig to find them, and wished her good luck. In truth, she had spoken a code-phrase to Paak, and found her way to a junction box where she contacted her buyer. ===Reckoning=== {{Quote|Pre-Mor enforcement put out a bulletin last night for someone matching Cassian's description.''"
"''I've seen it. The bulletin doesn't mention him by name. It says they're looking for someone from Kenari. His Imperial prison record says he's from Fest.''"
"''Yeah, that's always been his story.|Bix and Luthen talk about Cassian being a wanted man|}} [[File:BixCassian-Andor2.png|thumb|left|300px|At a cantina, Caleen informs Andor that her buyer is on his way to Ferrix.]] That night, the [[Time Grappler]] struck his{{Andor|That Would Be Me}} [[beskar]] anvil{{Andor|That Would Be Me}} {{AD|Disney+}} with a [[Hammer (tool)|hammer]], marking the end of the work day. At Karlo's salvage yard, Caleen tidied up as she prepared to retire for the day. On a nearby screen, a notice from [[Pre-Mor Security Inspection team]] in search of a Kenari male, matching Andor's description caught her [[eye]]. She quickly closed the screen as she was interrupted by Karlo, who invited her out for a [[Foodstuff|meal]]. She promised to share a meal with him the following day, before exiting the salvage yard. Karlo headed over to the screen and read the notice from Pre-Mor. Shortly after, Caleen attempted to contact Andor but was unable to reach him, but the two later met at a [[Cantina|bar]]. Caleen questioned Andor about the situation, and he revealed the events of the previous night, and insisted that he was provoked by the sentry guards and was not looking for trouble. Despite his earlier comments, Andor offered to sell the star path unit to her, but she replied that her buyer was already on the way and would arrive the following morning. He touched her [[Limb|hand]], and informed her he would not forget this deed, and she told him to leave. Unbeknownst to the pair, Karlo had been watching them from the distance. Drunk, he stumbled to a [[Gavalox Communications]]{{SW|url=andor-s1-e2-trivia-gallery|text="That Would Be Me" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 3}} where he contacted Pre-Mor authorities about Andor's presence on Ferrix. Unable to [[sleep]], Caleen soon arrived at Karlo's residence, where he invited her inside. The two embraced, and spent the night together. [[File:BixLuthen-Andor3.png|thumb|right|300px|Caleen meets with her buyer, Luthen Rael, and informs him of Andor's situation.]] The next morning, Caleen awoke to Karlo staring at her, and requested a mug of [[caf]]. As Karlo prepared the beverages, Caleen asked him to open the yard that morning, which he agreed to, asking what she had to do instead. She claimed to have a few errands to run, leaving Karlo unsatisfied. She made her way to a café where she waited for and eventually met her contact, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[Luthen Rael]]. She informed the man that [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|Pre-Mor Enforcement]] had put out a bulletin for Andor, with Rael replying he had seen it. Rael countered that they were looking for someone from the planet Kenari, whereas Andor's [[Imperial prison record]] had him listed as from [[Fest]]. Caleen confirmed that he was indeed from Kenari, but he had not yet been identified, as not many people on Ferrix knew him. Rael remarked that they should be quick, and Caleen informed him Andor was waiting in the [[East lot]], in [[building nine]]. Before parting ways, Rael asked Caleen if she trusted Andor, and she assured him that Andor would be there for the deal.{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}} ===Betrayals and blasters=== {{Quote|Did I ever tell you Cassian was born on Kenari?''"
"''I don't''[…]''I don't''[…]'' I don't remember.''"
"''I do. I remember.|Bix confronts Timm after he alerted Pre-Mor enforcement to Cassian's presence on Kenari|}} [[File:BixConfrontsTimm-Andor3.png|thumb|left|300px|Bix learns of Karlo's betrayal and goes in search of Andor.]] Caleen soon arrived at her salvage yard, questioning Karlo why there was still stuff piled up in the alley of the yard. He replied he had forgotten about it, before leaving to take care of it, leaving Caleen suspicious of her partner. Shortly after, Paak arrived at Caleen's salvage yard, notifying her that a group of [[Tac-Corpo|Corpos]] were looking for Andor, and were currently raiding Andor's mother, [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor's]] [[Andor household|house]]. Realizing that someone had betrayed Andor and ratted him out, Caleen set out to find her friend, but was stopped by Karlo, who claimed "he"—Andor— could take care of himself. As Karlo was not privy to her conversation with Paak, and therefore did not know they were talking about Andor, Caleen realized that it was Karlo who had ratted Andor out to Pre-Mor enforcement. She shoved him against the wall, questioning how he could betray her and Andor, before rushing out of the yard to search for Andor. [[File:PoorBix-Andor3.png|thumb|right|300px|After being brutally arrested, a shocked Caleen watches her lover being shot and killed in front of her.]] Running through an alley, Caleen spotted the [[North Team]] from the Pre-Mor Inspection team and changed course, but not before one of the Corpo's spotted her. [[North-1|One]] of them raised a [[blaster]] at her, while another ushered her against a wall. The Inspection Team's second-in-command, [[Sergeant]] [[Linus Mosk]], contacted the North Team asking for their location, and while they were distracted, Caleen attempted to flee, but was immediately seized by a Corpo, who slammed her head against the wall. Bruised and [[blood]]ied, Caleen was [[Stuncuffs|handcuffed]] to a pipe by the Corpo. Karlo soon arrived, demanding to know what they had done to her. North-1 raised his blaster at Karlo, ordering him to stop moving. Ignoring the [[officer]]'s command, Karlo charged at the officers, and was shot in the chest by [[North-3]], killing him. North Team left the area and headed for [[Rix Road]], leaving Caleen bound to the pipe, weeping for her fallen partner. Paak and Wilmon arrived shortly after and freed Caleen, halting her crawl to Karlo's body. The father and son dragged Caleen away from the stairs, leaving Karlo's corpse in the stairway. ===Cassian's return=== {{Quote|What happened to you?''"
"''I ran into a wall, like I do.|Caleen and Andor, upon his return to Ferrix|}} [[File:Cass_and_Bix.png|thumb|left|300px|Caleen meets with Andor after his return to Ferrix.]] Following the shootout on the planet, Andor and Rael fled Ferrix and headed to the planet [[Aldhani]].{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} Andor assisted the [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team]] to [[Aldhani heist|steal]] eighty million credits from the [[Aldhani Garrison]] on the planet, earning a cut of two-hundred thousand for his work.{{Andor|The Eye}} Following the heist, Andor returned to Ferrix where he spoke with Caleen at her salvage yard, which he entered by hopping over the wall. Andor reminisced about a time [[Standard year|years]] prior, when Caleen's [[Bix Caleen's father|father]] had reprimanded him for doing the same action. Caleen insisted that he should not have returned, and her salvage yard in particular was the last place he should have come to. Andor asked about Karlo—as he had previously been informed by his mother—that Karlo had been the one to rat him out. Caleen guessed that her deceased partner assumed that she and Andor had rekindled their relationship, fueling his jealousy, which caused him to alert Pre-Mor to Andor's location. Andor asked what happened to Caleen, noticing the gash above her brow, which was still healing after her arrest and abuse at the hands of the Corpos. Caleen replied that she had run into a wall, again insisting that she should not be at the yard. Andor assured her that the [[Stormtrooper|troopers]] would not catch him, but his friend said they would not have to, as he would be turned in. She reiterated that the residents of Ferrix blamed him for everything, as his actions had led to an Imperial occupation of the planet. Andor countered that if Karlo had kept quiet, they wouldnt have been in this situation.{{Andor|Announcement}} [[File:Cass_and_Bix_goodbye.png|thumb|right|300px|Andor leaves Caleen's salyard, promising to leave Ferrix for good.]] Caleen once again stated that he should leave and get as far away from Ferrix as possible, and Andor assured her that he will, and she won't have to worry about him anymore. Before leaving, he asks her about Rael, who had known every detail of Andor's life. Caleen replied that she did not know anything about him, and Andor accused her of lying. She stated that they were introduced by Paak—who swore he did not know anything. She added that she had a comm she contacted Rael on, and sometimes he responded, assuring Andor that he did not know about his life from her. Andor asked her to tell Rael that he held up his end of the bargain, and the man needed to forget about him, which went for everyone, her included. He pulled out a satchel containing twelve thousand credits, which covered the amount he owed to everyone on Ferrix. He scaled the wall to leave, and Caleen asked him to be careful, with Andor replying the same to her. ===Aftermath=== {{Quote|She fell trying to pry open the old Rix flood gate.''"
"''She gonna flush them out?''"
"''No. She wanted to see if the tunnel under the hotel was still open.''"
"''Why?''"
"''So the Rebellion can sneak in and take them by surprise. She's a rebel.|Caleen and Brasso, on Maarva Andor|}} Some time after Andor's return and immediate departure from Ferrix, Caleen went to visit Maarva Andor, who had grown ill and weary in the time since her son's disappearance. Caleen wondered if the older woman required a [[doctor]], noticing that her breathing sounded weak and she was dizzy, with her droid, [[B2EMO]], adding that she had pain in her knee. [[Brasso]], a mutual friend of Caleen and both Andor's, entered the residence, asking what had happened to Maarva, as he had heard she had to have been carried back to her house earlier after taking a fall. Later, outside the house, Brasso asked Caleen what Maarva was doing by [[Hotel Rix]], which the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] had used to set up their headquarters. Caleen replied that the old woman had become obsessed with troopers, and she fell while trying to pry open the Rix flood gate, hoping to find out if the tunnel under the hotel was still open. She said that Maarva hoped the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebellion]] would use the tunnel to come in and take the Imperials by surprise, voicing that the old woman was a rebel. Brasso stated that he should have come by Maarva's residence more often, and Caleen stated that she wasn't his mother, to which he replied that she wasn't her mother either.{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} [[File:Bix_and_brasso.png|thumb|left|250px|Caleen and Brasso discuss Maarva Andor's failing health.]] Brasso pondered if there was somewhere else Maarva could stay, as the cold in her home was making her condition worse. He suggested the social group{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} [[Daughters of Ferrix]], who Maarva had served as a [[President]] for in the past, might have a warm room, but Caleen affirmed that the older woman had made her intentions clear—she wished to stay in her home. They guessed that Maarva's condition had worsened because of Cassian's disappearance. Caleen asked Brasso if he knew where their friend was, and the man shook his head in the negative. Unbeknownst to Brasso and Caleen, [[Vel Sartha]] and [[Cinta Kaz]], who were part of the Rebel infiltration team on Aldhani that Cassian had worked with, were spying on them from across the street. The two women had been ordered by [[Kleya Marki]], who was an assistant to Caleen's contact Rael, to find Cassian and kill him, as having him out in the wild with information about Rael was a risk. Caleen then made her way to the Repaak Salyard, where Paak asked her if her business was as slow as his, which she confirmed, adding that losing the hotel has been bad for business. Paak mentioned that they should call a meeting, and find out if there was something they could do. Caleen asked if she could "look for something in the back", meaning she wanted to use his comm unit. Paak warned against it, but ultimately allowed her to use it. She turned on the unit and began tapping out a transmission to Rael, asking for Cassian's whereabouts. On the planet [[Coruscant]], Rael's assistant Marki received the transmission, and while Rael wished to reply as he was also searching for Andor, Marki advised against it, as it could be the ISB watching her radio. Rael and Marki eventually closed off the transmission, cutting all contact with Caleen and Ferrix. Caleen, growing irate due to the lack of response for Rael, desperately tapped out on the comm unit, to no avail. ===Taken prisoner=== [[File:SWEncyclopedia-Bixtakenprisoners.png|thumb|right|300px|Caleen is taken prisoner by Imperial troopers.]] The next morning, Caleen heard the banging of objects by the citizens of Ferrix, and made her way to the Paak's salyard, which had a crowd surrounding it. Brasso informed Caleen that they had arrested Paak the previous night, and the two watched as Wilmon demanded to know where the Imperials had taken his father. The lead Imperial officer, [[Captain]] [[Vanis Tigo]], ordered the streets to be cleared just as his gaze landed on Caleen. Confirming her identity, Tigo called out to her and ordered his troopers to arrest her, but not before Brasso told her to flee to [[Zorby]]'s [[Zorby's Western Shiplot|Western Shiplot]]. Caleen ran away with a head start, but the Imperials eventually caught up to her, putting her in stuncuffs. They led her to a room in the hotel that contained a depleted Paak, who had been tortured for information. ISB [[Lieutenant]] [[Dedra Meero]]—who had been given command of the Morlana Sector, and by extension Ferrix, to help with her investigation into Rael, whom she identified as a central rebel figure she knew as "Axis"—ordered the troopers to remove Paak from the room and greeted Caleen, gesturing for her to be seated in Paak's now-vacated seat. ===Caught in a net=== {{Quote|The very worst thing you can do right now is bore me.''"
"''You're not gonna believe me anyway, are you?''"
"''No. I suppose not.|Meero, interrogating Caleen.|}} [[File:Bix_and_Dedra.png|thumb|left|250px|Dedra Meero interrogates Caleen.]] Meero began her interrogation of Caleen by setting herself apart from her ISB colleagues, stating that whereas everyone else was lacking, she actually tried. The ISB Lieutenant asked for Caleen's cooperation, but failing that, she introduced [[Doctor]] [[Gorst]], who has developed a new and unique interrogation system that the Empire was excited about. Meero explained that they had arrested Paak after tracing a radio in his yard, and despite having very little rebellious activity to his name, resisted the ISB, leading them to torture the man. She revealed everything she had learned from Paak to Caleen—Paak was acting a liaison for Ferrix, not for political purposes but to use the planet's commercial position to acquire stolen Imperial equipment. She added that Caleen was the only person to use Paak's radio, and her contact had only met with Paak once, leading the ISB supervisor to believe there were motivations larger than money at play.{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}} Meero attempted to persuade Caleen to cooperate by saying she had no history of political chaos, and it did not make sense to go through the trouble of torture if her motivations were only for money. After staying silent the entire time, Caleen finally spoke up, simply stating that Meero was ISB, the worst of all the Imperials. Meero demanded to know everything about her contact, the contact's relationship with Andor, and a full detailed accounting of every piece of Imperial equipment she had dealt with. Caleen retorted that the buyer—Rael, although Meero was not aware of his identity—had no relationship with Andor. She added that she did not know the buyer, which Meero knew was a lie as Paak had told her Caleen had met with him at least six times. Caleen said that she would only go to the radio and signal her contact—sometimes he would answer, come to the planet, buy the equipment, and leave. Meero continued, expressing that Caleen had been injured trying to protect Andor, and Karlo was killed trying to win her freedom, explaining that it was in fact a nest of relationships. The ISB supervisor asked Caleen when the last time she spoke to Andor was, earning no response. Meero stressed that the worst thing Caleen could do was bore her, with Caleen firing back, saying the ISB supervisor wasn't going to believe her anyway. Meero exited the room, leaving Gorst to torture Caleen. [[File:Tortured_Bix.png|thumb|right|250px|Caleen gave up all the information Meero asked of her after being tortured.]] The doctor explained his new torture method, emphasizing that it was best Caleen was tied down during it. Gorst explained that a [[moon]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] called [[Dizon Fray]] had resisted the building of an Imperial refueling center that was being built, and all of the [[Sentience|sentient]] species of the planet, the [[Dizonite]]s, were eliminated entirely. He added that the Dizonites made a unique sound as they were being killed, which the Imperials modified and weaponized—zeroing in on the sound made by Dizonite children. Meero returned to the room, urging Caleen to cooperate, as repeat listenings of the Dizonite screams caused the most damage. Gorst placed a pair of headphones on Caleen's head, drilling the sounds into Caleen's ears, as she sat there, screaming. After some time, Meero palmed the face of a depleted Caleen, once again asking her when the last time she spoke with Andor was. Caleen eventually gave up all the information Meero asked of her, except the identity of her contact, who Meero had dubbed "Axis." The ISB supervisor reported her findings to her colleagues at the [[ISB Central Office|ISB headquarters office]] on Coruscant. Caleen had told Meero that Andor had shaved his beard the last time she saw him, which led Meero to believe he was linked to the heist on Aldhani. ===Bricked=== {{Quote|He'll find us. Cassian will find us.''"
"''I will. I'll find you.|Caleen and Andor|}} [[File:Bix_sad.png|thumb|left|250px|Caleen was questioned by the Imperials if Anto Kreeygyr was her contact.]] Traumatized at the torture she received at the hands of the Gorst and the Imperials, Caleen constantly heard the voices of the doctor in her head while being held captive at the hotel. The Imperial [[Merzin Keysax]] entered her room and brought her to the headquarters office of the Imperials, as she limped against his body, struggling to stand up straight. [[Corv]], an ISB attendant under Meero, informed Caleen that he was going to ask her a question and expected an honest answer, and if he was not sure if she was telling the truth, he would recall Doctor Gorst to extract the truth from her. He activated a [[holoprojector]] which displayed an image of [[Anto Kreegyr]], a former [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] turned-rebel, who was a contact of Rael's. Corv knelt next to Caleen and asked her if Kreegyr was the man she introduced to Cassian Andor, and the woman began crying,{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} The former Separatist was eventually killed by ISB as they had learned his plans for an [[Spellhaus attack|attack]] on [[Spellhaus]].{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} During Caleen's imprisonment at the hotel, Maarva Andor had passed away due to her illness'. As per Ferrix custom, she was bricked—her ashes were mixed with mortar and local stone dust, and turned into a Ferrix brick. The ISB, hoping to lure Cassian back to Ferrix, allowed the Daughters of Ferrix to hold a funeral procession for the late Andor on [[Rix Road]]. Andor did indeed return to Ferrix after hearing about his mother's passing from the freighter [[Xanwan]], and headed for Caleen's salyard. There, he found [[Pegla]], who worked at Zorby's shiplot, and his [[Corellian hound|Corellian junkyard hounds]].{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}} Pegla informed Andor that he was keeping an eye on Caleen's salyard until they sell it, leading Andor to question Caleen's whereabouts. Later, Andor met with Brasso who informed him that Caleen was still being held in the hotel, adding that she was alive three days ago, likely because she still had information to give. Andor told his friend that he would not leave Caleen there, and Brasso told him to take care of himself. As Maarva's funeral procession began, led by the Daughters of Ferrix and the Ferrix [[Honor guard (Ferrix)|honor guard]], Caleen peered out the window of the hotel to watch, and hummed along to the tune of the [[band]]. As the parade began to chant "stone and sky," Caleen chanted along with them from her prison room, and watched as B2EMO played a recording of Maarva speaking to the Ferrixians. [[File:Bix_escape.png|thumb|right|250px|Brasso helps Caleen onto the ship after Andor broke her out of the Imperial headquarters.]] As the bulk of troopers and officers had been stationed outside to keep an eye on the parade, the corridors of the hotel were left mostly empty, giving Andor an opening to rescue Caleen. Andor reached the room she was being held in, and she informed him that she had a [[dream]] that he came back for her. They quickly reminisced about Maarva before Andor urged her to follow him. Originally hesitant due to fear of the ISB, Caleen followed Andor out the hotel, fighting off Imperial [[death trooper]]s in the process. They move off to a narrow street and made way to Zorby's starship lot where Pegla was helping Brasso and Daughter of Ferrix [[Jezzi]] get a [[starship]] off the planet, along with B2EMO and Wilmon. Brasso helped Bix onto the ship, and Andor asked Pegla if they could make it [[Gangi Moon]]. He ordered Jezzi to keep the ship low all the way to [[Farside Sea]], only climbing once they crossed the body of water, and urged her not to use comms. B2EMO questioned Andor if he was coming with them, and the man replied in the negative, telling his droid to take care of Caleen until he arrived. Caleen weakly stated that Andor would find them, and her friend assured her that he will. ===Life on Mina-Rau=== ====Hiding in plain sight==== {{Quote|We're toolies.''"
"''There's all kinds of people here.''"
"''Yeah, with shares and visas.''"
"''Well, they all started somewhere.''"
"''It's not that easy.''"
"''Doesn't seem to be stopping Talia and Brasso.|Wilmon Paak and Caleen, on their status as immigrants|{{Andor|One Year Later}}}} [[File:CaleenNightmares-Andor-OneYearLater.png|250px|thumb|left|Caleen had a recurring nightmare of Gorst following her torture by the doctor.]] By [[4 BBY]],{{AndorDate|202}} a year since Caleen and the others went into hiding, they went on to hide on the planet [[Mina-Rau]] as mechanics. During one of the nights, Caleen had a nightmare of being stalked and pulled by Doctor Gorst, which woke her up in terror. Later in the morning, both Caleen and Paak were switching out components for a faulty [[irrigation tower]] in the middle of a remote crop field. As they continued working on the tower, Caleen noticed the human [[Beela]]—who had an interest on Paak—closely approaching the two and joked that Paak was thirsty. In response, Paak pleaded for Caleen to stop the tease and added that Beela's [[Parent|mother]], [[Aneth]],{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} disapproved of the relationship due to him being unregistered and not having the proper visa. As Beela arrived, however, the meeting was cut short by an [[Imperial scan cruiser]] in the sky. Brasso later informed them that the Imperials had not come in years, which the human [[Talia (Mina-Rau)|Talia]] then added that she had been on Mina-Rau for eight years and never seen it either. Their arrival was revealed to be an [[Imperial Supply Census]], an audit to check supply and its sources, though not much else could be known at the time. On the next day, Caleen, Brasso, and Paak were fixing the [[mega silo]]s when the human [[Kellen]] came to inform them an update of where the Empire might head next for the audit. According to his{{Databank|kellen|Kellen}} friends at the [[Council Five Hundred]], Kellen mentioned that the Empire might be done auditing there by the end of that day. However, they would need to wait and see as to where the Empire might head next, before getting a sense of their general direction. Caleen asked how many troops the Empire got on ground for the audit to which Kellen responded around forty, though he was unsure of the air support. Kellen then added that the Empire were fully aware that everyone might not be a legal worker and that it had been a [[Standard decade|decade]] since the last audit. Brasso suggested they take the risk of hoping that the Empire might let them slip, however, Caleen was against it. Caleen proceeded to suggest of staying ahead of the Empire, though Kellen warned them as someone was caught at Five Hundred for doing the same. Before leaving, Kellen asked for an update on Andor's whereabouts and Caleen responded that he would be there. [[File:BrassoCaleenSilo-Andor-SagronaTeema.png|275px|thumb|right|Brasso came in time to stop Krole's unwanted advances toward Caleen.]] Later that day, some personnel of an [[Krole's contingent|Imperial contingent]] came for a quick visit prior to their official auditing duty. The leader of the contingent, [[Lieutenant]] [[Krole]], went to the silos and met up with Caleen. He{{Andor|Harvest}} started a small conversation by mentioning the new silos at the [[Council Six Hundred]] and how they were not worth the cost, adding that they would know for sure after the next harvest. Krole continued on and started to flirt, though Caleen shut him down by mentioning her "husband" who went offworld for a couple of days. Despite it, Krole tried to push further on Caleen, however, Brasso came in time to stop the unwanted advances. ====Escaping evil==== {{Quote|The Councils need the help or there's no harvest. The help is undocumented. The rules are clear, but the situation requires…nuance. It all ends up on me.|Krole, to Caleen|}} The next day, Caleen and the others had a small feast in the middle of the field. Kellen then shortly arrived to give another update to Brasso on the Imperial audit, informing him that they were next on the schedule. After the small feast, Caleen, Paak, and Brasso quickly prepared their exit from the premises and planned to leave by sundown. Later, A [[TIE/rp Reaper attack lander]] flew by and prompted Caleen to check on the radio, hoping that it was Andor, though Brasso told her that they should not wait. Brasso added that the Imperial had started a sweep at the far fields and would eventually return. Knowing that they could get pinned down, they started their move early. However, Paak was nowhere to be seen, halting Caleen and Brasso to search for him, with the latter leaving on a [[speeder]]. With Caleen left all alone, she noticed that Krole was on his way for the audit and greeted him. Upon walking near to the premises, the Imperial officer had grown suspicious after realizing that Caleen's equipment was packed up, prompting Caleen to lie about an emergency repair over at the [[Eight Hundred Block]]. Krole then entered Caleen's home to inspect further. When inside, Krole looked around the small home before calling Caleen out for being an "illegal." He added that for the harvest to achieve the best result, it required some nuance—including help from undocumented individuals—despite Imperial rules prohibiting it. In response, Caleen pretended to be understanding toward Krole. However, in that moment, the Imperial officer attempted to sexually assault Caleen, though she was able to fight back and eventually hit Krole with a metal equipment to his head. Krole then limped out of Caleen's home, shortly before falling to his death, which alarmed a trooper waiting outside, [[Corporal]] [[Pyke (individual)|Pyke]]. The corporal quickly reported for backup as he{{Andor|Harvest}} {{AD|Disney+}} held his blaster up against Caleen's home. Paak soon returned and distracted Pyke, which Caleen took advantage of, killing the corporal from the side. Immediately after, a [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]] appeared in the sky as it gunned down Imperial personnel. Caleen was confident that Andor was piloting the ship and told Paak to get the speeder. The two managed to meet up with Andor and swiftly left Mina-Rau, though Brasso did not make it out of the Imperial altercation. ===Dreading Coruscant=== ====Haunting nightmares==== {{Quote|I don't wanna lose you again.''"
"''That's not up to us anymore.|Andor and Caleen, discussing the latter's safety|}} By [[3 BBY]], a year since their departure from Mina-Rau, both Caleen and Andor had lived in the [[Axis network safehouse]].{{Databank|axis-network-safehouse|Axis Network safehouse}} In that same year, Caleen and Andor were sent out by Rael for a mission. While on the mission, an [[Unidentified Imperial soldier (Bix Caleen)|Imperial soldier]] saw Caleen's face and was killed by Andor as a mean to protect her. During the next night, Caleen woke up from her sleep and walked over to another room only to see Gorst torturing the same soldier Andor had killed. Without hesitation, Caleen held up a blaster against the doctor at first sight. Before pulling the trigger, however, Andor slowly came in and pulled the blaster away from her grasp, revealing that it was all just another nightmare. Andor tried to comfort Caleen by asking if she wanted to talk about her Gorst-related nightmares. While she initially denied the help, Caleen then opened up about how the nightmares came haunting when she relaxed. Caleen tried to pivot the discussion and focused on buying house appliances, though she broke down in tears as Andor comforted her. Later that day, Caleen and Andor walked over to the bodega [[Samo's]] to prepare for dinner. They bought three [[melon]]s, a spicy [[moski pepper]], and a [[peezo]] handed over by Andor. Shortly after returning from the bodega, Caleen cleaned up blaster components as Andor prepared dinner. She asked Andor if anyone had lived in the safehouse prior, which he then ensured Caleen that no one was living in it while they were out. Caleen proceeded to bring up the soldier Andor killed on their mission and how they were supposed to tell Rael. Andor ensured her that Rael only cared for results and that what happened to the soldier needed to be done. The two continued to argue about the soldier's fate, though it ended without a clear resolution. [[File:BixPills-EverBeenToGhorman.png|left|thumb|250px|Bix consumed addictive sleeping drops]] At night, the pair ate dinner with Caleen complementing Andor's cooking, adding that he was better than her at it. The two planned for a walk in the morning and Caleen suggested that they go to a big park. However, Andor was entirely against it, fearing for its wide camera surveillance and Caleen's safety. Caleen argued that her safety was not up to either of them anymore and that she wanted to win if it meant giving up on everything. After going to bed, she woke up in the middle of the night and looked out the window. Her disappearance woke Andor as well. He asked if it was another nightmare about Gorst, but turned out to be a light blinking from a distant building. The following day, Caleen and Andor had an intimate dance shortly before the latter left for a mission by Rael to the planet [[Ghorman]]. Caleen then pulled out a small pipette and ingested a tiny amount of [[sleeping drops]]. ====A struggle to end==== {{Quote|I use it for sleep.''"
"''It works for a while, but the dreams come back worse when you stop.|Caleen and Rael, on the former's substance abuse|{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}}}} While Andor was still on his mission to Ghorman, Luthen came to visit the safehouse. Upon answering the door, Caleen was initially shocked, as she believed Rael had come to break the news of Andor's death to her, though he quickly reassured her that nothing of the sort had happened and claimed that Andor would return soon. Rael wandered inside and reminisced about the safehouse for a bit before Caleen caught on his actual intent to visit. He wanted to offer Caleen a job, weapons appraisal; however, when Rael saw her condition—visibly unwell due to her constant nightmares—he decided to wait for her to recover fully. Additionally, Rael offered to look for another more "exciting" job down the line and suggested for her to rest, though Caleen was hesitant on still taking the job. In response, Rael held up a small vial of sleeping drops Caleen had been taking and warned her against its long-term usage. Caleen understood that Rael needed her healthy, with the latter nodded in agreement. Later during the day, Caleen laid down as she watched the entertainment program ''[[Good Morning, Coruscant]]'' with a blank stare while holding a blaster pistol on one hand. [[File:Bix-Gorst-WhatAFestiveEvening.png|Bix forces the Dizonite helmet onto Gorst's head|thumb|230px]] Cassian completed his mission and returned to Coruscant. He was furious to learn that Rael had attempted to recruit her for a mission when he was absent. Andor visited Luthen and confronted him. Luthen rebutted and called him and Bix a 'disappointment' and told Andor to get Bix's drug habit in check quickly. Caleen and Andor executed their plan to kill Dr. Gorst and ensure his technology would not be replicated. Caleen infiltrated the building he was in and subjected him to the same torture she had experienced at his hands, at an even higher level. Caleen escaped the building, reuniting with Andor and they activated the explosives they had planted, destroying the building.{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} ===Yavin=== {{Quote|My love. You're sleeping now. You look so peaceful. I wanna be brave, but I can't. If I was brave, I would stay and do this in person... but I know you and you'd just talk me around, and I've been thinking about this too long to let that happen. I have to leave. I have to go away. I'm not sure where or for how long, I just know that I can't stay here with you now. I believe what you said. It is a choice. It just can’t be me. I can’t be the reason you leave here. If you gave this up for me I’d-I’d never forgive myself. We have to win. We have to beat them and I believe you have purpose in making that happen. I need to believe that. So, I’m choosing for the both of us. I choose the rebellion.|Bix Caleen, to Cassian Andor|}} By [[2 BBY]], Bix and Cassian had moved to [[Yavin 4]], and reunited with [[Wilmon Paak]]. Paak told Andor that Luthen needed him, for a mission to assassinate [[Dedra Meero]]. Andor was hesitant and left. Paak tried to convince Caleen that the mission was a good idea. Later, Caleen and Andor walked to the [[Great Temple]], and met a [[Unidentified Force healer|Force healer]] outside. Caleen convinced Andor to pay attention to her and go in open minded and Andor obliges. The healer told Caleen that Bix is where Andor needs to be, before touching her hand and leaving. Caleen told Andor of the force healer's words, describing him as a 'messenger'. They hug each other. The next day, [[Vel Sartha]] visited Caleen in her hut on Yavin, lamenting how long it had been since they last met. Sartha explains that she has been sent to talk to Cassian. Sartha told Caleen they have come a long way since their missions for Luthen and asked whether Andor is capable of leading. Caleen told her that Andor will be there when the rebels need him. After returning to Yavin, Cassian awoke from slumber and discovered his hut to be empty. Andor found a datapad on his table with a message from Bix. Shaken by the cryptic prophecy from the Force healer,{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-interview-adria-arjona-bix-caleen|text=''Andor'' Star Adria Arjona Finds Justice for Bix Caleen}} Caleen told Andor she could never forgive herself if she was the reason that Andor left the rebellion, valuing the mission to destroy the Empire over her own happiness. Andor sprinted to the Yavin castle and asked about departing transports only to be told that Caleen had just left. ===Return to Mina Rau=== [[File:Bix-Child-JedhaKyberErso.jpg|250px|right|thumb|Caleen holding her and Andor's child]] Bix returned to [[Mina-Rau]], where she chose to live,{{InsiderCite|234|Jedi Master's Quiz}} and reunited with [[Talia (Mina-Rau)|Talia]] and [[B2EMO]]. By [[1 BBY]], she had given birth to a healthy child: Cassian's.{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}} ==Personality and traits== [[File:BixCaleen-TWBM.png|thumb|left|200px|Bix Caleen was a clever woman and a skilled mechanic.]] Bix Caleen was a [[human]] woman with [[Color|brown-black]] hair, brown eyes, and tan skin. She was a skilled mechanic and took over her parents' salvage yard after their deaths. A hardworking woman, Caleen was known to be handy and strong, and was smarter and stronger than most people around her believed. The mechanic was also known to take charge and control of situations, which was reflected in how the people around her behaved. Caleen had been in-and-out of a relationship with Cassian Andor ever since they were [[Youngling|children]], and the two knew everything there was to know about each other. Despite this, it was impossible for the two of them to be together due to Cassian having burned every bridge with her. Selfless and loyal, Caleen acted as a great friend and confidant to Andor. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Bix is a hardworking woman. She's a complicated woman who is very handy and strong. I wouldn't necessarily consider her tough, but I think she's a lot stronger and a lot smarter than a lot of people may think she is.|Adria Arjona|}} [[File:BixCaleen-SWCT.png|thumb|right|200px|Caleen was portrayed by Adria Arjona.]] Portrayed by [[Adria Arjona]], Bix Caleen was created for the [[2022]] live-action television series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']].{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} She was first identified in [[Wikipedia:SFX (magazine)|''SFX'' magazine]].{{BookCite|container=Star Wars: Andor|title=SFX|number=Issue 356|publisher=[[Wikipedia:SFX (magazine)|''SFX'' magazine]]|date=[[September]] [[2022]]|issn=9771358595111|quote=Bix Caleen (Adria Arjona) does some Lara Crofting}} Bix first appeared in "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," the first episode of the series, as a part of its three-episode premiere. [[File:BixCaleenConceptArt.jpg|thumb|left|140px|Andrei Riabovitchev created concept art of Bix Caleen based on a design by Michael Wilkinson]] Executive producer and writer [[Tony Gilroy]] chose to have Caleen be tortured by an auditory device to make the scene be different from other scenes in cinema.{{SW|url=news/adria-arjona-andor-interview|text=Losing Bix: Andor's Adria Arjona on the Downward Spiral of Bix Caleen}} Costume designer [[Michael Wilkinson]] and his team gave Caleen a unique silhouette to help her stand out in a crowd. The costume was meant to reflect her practicality and utilitarianism.{{SW|url=news/dressing-the-galaxy-designer-michael-wilkinson-defines-the-look-of-andor-s-costumes|text=Dressing the Galaxy: Designer Michael Wilkinson Defines the Look of Andor's Costumes}} Artist [[Andrei Riabovitchev]] created concept art based on Wilkinson's design.{{Instagram|username=riabovitchev|url=p/CmHBAiZqgxv|name=[[Andrei Riabovitchev]]|date=2022-12-13|quote=Some of my costume illustrations done for Star Wars TV series Andor, costume designer Michael Wilkinson.|archivedate=20230106232221}} The costume team created a jacket with an iconic neckline. Due to Ferrix's cold environment, they also included texture, a fleece lining, and a [[Wikipedia:Carhartt|Carhartt]]-like aesthetic. Composer [[Nicholas Britell]] created a musical signature for Caleen.{{WebCite|url=https://variety.com/2022/artisans/news/andor-composer-nicholas-britell-score-star-wars-1235383443|text=‘Andor' Composer Nicholas Britell Breaks Down His Score and Why He Incorporated Rustling Leaves|author=Burlingame, Jon|date=2022-09-26|work=[[Wikipedia:Variety (magazine)|''Variety'']]|archivedate=20220926170019}} Arjona's ethnicity was not an active part of her casting.{{SW|url=news/andor-launch-interview-gilroy-and-cast|text="A Potent Moment in History": Insights from Tony Gilroy and the ''Andor'' Cast}} After Gilroy told her she had the role,{{YouTube|video=0q25e6uuFwA|text="Star Wars means so much!" Diego Luna and the Andor cast on auditions, tricky lines and falling over|channel=@bbcradio1|name=BBC Radio 1}} they discussed Caleen's character arc at length.{{SW|url=news/adria-arjona-andor-interview|text=Losing Bix: Andor's Adria Arjona on the Downward Spiral of Bix Caleen}} The actress was immediately drawn to how Caleen's tough exterior protects her vulnerable core. Arjona liked how her character is fearless, bold, deep inside, loyal, compassionate, and cares too much for others. She described Caleen as a hardworking and complicated woman who is often underestimated by people. Arjona used notepads to plot and connect the dots that would take Caleen to where she ended up in the series. The actress believed that Timm Karlo's betrayal completely broke Caleen and took her down a spiral where she was no longer herself. Arjona asked Gilroy if she could turn Caleen into a child that could not take care of herself towards the end of the series. Scenes on Ferrix were filmed in an intricate set in [[Wikipedia:Marlow, Buckinghamshire|Little Marlow]], [[Wikipedia:Buckinghamshire|Buckinghamshire]]. According to Gilroy, everything on Ferrix was filmed first.{{WebCite|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-features/andor-season-2-post-credits-scene-tony-gilroy-1235268962|text=‘Andor' Creator Tony Gilroy Talks Luthen's Good Day, That Post-Credit Scene and Season Two|author=Davids, Brian|date=2022-11-23|work=[[Wikipedia:The Hollywood Reporter|''The Hollywood Reporter'']]|archivedate=20221123185515}} When asked if [[Bix Caleen's child]] had a name, Arjona said that she had her own hypothetical answer. Gilroy stated that the baby had not been identified in any way.{{YouTube|video=eUFx9QYNMd8|text='Andor' Season 2 Spoiler Interviews With Diego Luna, Adria Arjona, Denise Gough And
